data.body:
Most beginners are pushed toward more products before they understand what their skin is actually asking for. That is how simple routines become expensive, confusing, and hard to trust.

Dr. Lurié Skin Care gives you a physician-led starting point: learn the basics, choose one clear next step, and build confidence before you buy more.
data.heading: Stop buying skincare advice. Start understanding your skin.
data.kicker: For skincare beginners who are tired of guessing
